description: Rockwell Automation, Inc. is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation, understanding and simplifying its customers' complex production challenges and delivering the most valued solutions that combine technology and industry expertise, as a result making its customers more resilient, agile and sustainable. The company continues the business founded as the Allen-Bradley Company in 1903, which was a leading North American manufacturer of industrial automation equipment when the former Rockwell International Corporation purchased it in 1985, and it was incorporated in Delaware in connection with a tax-free reorganization completed on December 6, 1996.
